bak.description: background-noise score per measurement, 1-5 (5 = not noticeable). Entry i covers [i*step_seconds, i*step_seconds+measurement_seconds) on the delivered timeline; null where the audio held too little speech to score

measurement_count.description: number of entries in each of the arrays below

measurement_seconds.description: seconds of audio each score describes (fixed by the model)

metric.description: always "dnsmos_p835" — ITU-T P.835 scores predicted by Microsoft DNSMOS

model.description: model file and licence the scores came from

ovr.description: overall score per measurement, 1-5; null on the same entries as bak

sig.description: speech-signal score per measurement, 1-5; null on the same entries as bak

step_seconds.description: seconds between consecutive measurements; measurements overlap
